transferValues.owner: Greek Ministry of National Economy and Finance
transferValues.dataset: Register of Real Estate Transfer Values
transferValues.changes: The data have been processed: medians of comparable contracts only (whole property, full ownership, no special conditions), matched to Kallikratis areas.

valueZones.owner: Greek Ministry of National Economy and Finance
valueZones.dataset: Zones of the objective property valuation system
valueZones.changes: The data have been processed: converted from GGRS87 to WGS84, boundaries simplified within 2 m, split by municipal unit.

method.contract: Contract prices are what was declared in transfer contracts, from the public Register of Real Estate Transfer Values. They are not a valuation or market value, and the declared price may differ from the actual one.
method.comparable: We count only contracts for a whole property in full ownership, with no special conditions (unfinished, listed, expropriation). Shares, bare ownership and usufruct are left out.
method.zone: The zone price is the basis of the objective value per m², before the floor, age and frontage coefficients. The ratio of price to zone price shows how far above or below the tax basis contracts are signed.
method.cadence: The register is updated about once a month; contract data run to the date shown in each section.
method.valueZone: Zones and their prices are those currently in force, published by the Ministry of National Economy and Finance. A street-frontage zone price applies only to properties with frontage on that street; with several frontages the highest applies. The zone price is not the objective value, which also depends on floor, age, frontage and other coefficients.
